definitions.explanation: Indicating that a product was manufactured in China. Frequently seen on consumer goods sold in Japan.

examples.japanese: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This clothing is made in China, but the quality is good.

examples.japanese: ⟦{近年|きんねん}→近年：14349_kinnen⟧、{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電気自動車|でんきじどうしゃ}→電気自動車：15581_denkijidousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}している→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: In recent years, Chinese-made electric cars have been spreading around the world.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧ (China) + the suffix ⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧ (made in/of). Parallel to ⟦{日本製|にほんせい}→日本製：28455_nihonsei⟧, {韓国製|かんこくせい}, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- As a noun modifier: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun
- As a predicate: {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}だ / です

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧: Chinese-made appliances
- {中国製|ちゅうごくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧: Chinese-made parts
- ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧{中国製|ちゅうごくせい}: cheap Chinese-made (goods)
